evidence: The biomedical sentence embeddings are also negative globally: text-only 0.2338 / 0.2507; SVD+text 0.3383 / 0.4205 versus SVD 0.3592 / 0.4122 — micro +0.008 but macro −0.021.
metric: text-only 0.2338 / 0.2507; SVD 0.3592 / 0.4122; SVD+text 0.3383 / 0.4205; 768 dimensions; 15,007 nodes embedded
observation: A 768-dimensional PubMedBERT sentence encoder replaced TF-IDF for the same node-text probe. Text-only scoring fell further and adding it to the SVD traded a small micro gain for a macro loss, so the negative text result was not an artifact of lexical matching.
subject: F-76
title: Biomedical sentence embeddings are also negative globally
